en.title: Indoor solar lights for the girls' dormitories
en.summary: Power failures during exam season interrupted study. The 5th batch put solar lighting in the girls' dormitories.
en.body:
This project was undertaken by the 5th batch in association with Menda Foundation with a total cost of ₹2.50 lakhs.

**Problem Solved:**
Power problems in girls' dormitory during exam time due to frequent power failures.

The Alumni Association wishes the 5th batch, led by Arun Gowda, all the best for their continued support.

---

kn.title: ಹುಡುಗಿಯರ ವಸತಿಗೃಹಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಳಾಂಗಣ ಸೌರ ದೀಪಗಳು
kn.summary: ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವೈಫಲ್ಯ ಓದಿಗೆ ಅಡ್ಡಿಯಾಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು. 5ನೇ ಬ್ಯಾಚ್ ಹುಡುಗಿಯರ ವಸತಿಗೃಹಗಳಿಗೆ ಸೌರ ದೀಪ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿತು.
